text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: *INCIDENT OPENED* :rotating_light:
Service/Area: Dedicated Fleet Provisioning (provision-to-ready)
Symptom: provisioning runs stuck in *Bootstrapping* > 35m
Severity: SEV-2 (pilot impact; risk to customer expansion window)
Commander: @Rafael Mendes
Channel: #incidents

Rafael Mendes: Kicking this off. We have 3 provisioning runs in pilot stuck in Bootstrapping. Looks like cluster comes up, nodes join, then bootstrap never transitions to Validating. Seeing repeated helm install/upgrade failures from fleet-provisioner.

Vanessa Ortiz: Confirmed on my end. Runs affected:
- pool `ded-pilot-usw2-a10-07` run `prun_8d2c` (corr `p2r-01HQA5...`)
- pool `ded-pilot-euc1-h100-02` run `prun_8d31`
- pool `ded-stg-use1-a10-12` run `prun_8d33`
All stuck in Bootstrapping with retries.

Ethan Park: Seeing the same in control plane. State machine is looping Bootstrapping -> Bootstrapping (retry). No Ready transitions. Good news: routing is respecting Ready gating, so nothing is being advertised.

Vikram Singh: Pulled logs from fleet-provisioner. Error is consistent:
```
helm upgrade --install redwood-runtime redwood/runtime \
  --namespace redwood-system \
  -f /tmp/bootstrap/values.yaml

Error: UPGRADE FAILED: template: runtime/templates/deployment.yaml:145:21: executing "runtime/templates/deployment.yaml" at <.Values.runtime.env[0].name>: can't evaluate field name in type interface {}
```
So values shape doesn’t match chart expectation.

Nina Petrova: That looks like someone passed runtime.env as a map vs list of {name,value}. Was there a recent change to the “golden config” generator?

Gabe Wilson: Yeah, I think so. The new pipeline step that merges pool config -> helm values started emitting:
```
runtime:
  env:
    LOG_LEVEL: info
```
but chart expects:
```
runtime:
  env:
    - name: LOG_LEVEL
      value: "info"
```
That would explain template failure.

Rafael Mendes: OK, cause identified: misconfigured helm values emitted by pipeline (bootstrapping stage). Next: mitigation to unblock pilot. Options:
1) hotfix values generation + re-run bootstrapping stage
2) manual helm override for impacted pools, then continue validation
Preference is (1) but time-sensitive.

Connor O'Brien: What’s the next customer window? We had that expansion planned later today right?

Harish Reddy: Customer expansion is *tomorrow 9am PT* (SUP-2201). We planned to finish pilot today. If we can unblock within the next hour we’re OK.

Vanessa Ortiz: I can do a targeted patch in fleet-provisioner to coerce env map -> list for now (backward compatible) and ship behind the staging feature flag. Then rerun Bootstrapping on the stuck runs.

Miles Thornton: +1 for coercion guard. Also: add a validation gate earlier so we fail fast at config-validate instead of mid-bootstrap. Bootstrapping retries will just churn.

Kira Thompson: For runbook clarity: can someone paste the exact operator steps for rerunning Bootstrapping after patch? I’ll update the “stuck in Bootstrapping” section once we confirm.

Rafael Mendes: Let’s do:
- Vanessa + Gabe: patch values generator / coercion and open PR
- Ethan + Vikram: confirm no unsafe side effects (does chart accept both forms?)
- Harish: hold off on manual changes for 20 min while we ship; if we can’t ship in time we’ll do manual helm override as backup

Vanessa Ortiz: Working on it. Here’s the proposed transform (pseudo):
- if `.runtime.env` is map[string]string, convert to list of {name,value}
- if `.runtime.env` already list, leave as-is
Also adding lint rule in config validation: reject map form unless `--break-glass`.

deploy-bot: Build started for `fleet-provisioner` (branch `hotfix/env-values-shape`).

Ethan Park: I checked runtime chart. Template iterates `.Values.runtime.env` assuming list. It *will* accept list only. So coercion is correct.

Vikram Singh: Also seeing another key in values.yaml:
```
runtime:
  resources:
    limits:
      nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
```
That part is fine. The only failure is env shape.

Gabe Wilson: Found the commit that introduced map form in the merge step. It was intended to simplify config but chart never got updated. We should keep list in chart values for now.

Rafael Mendes: Status update: Impact limited to provisioning pipeline; no customer traffic impact. But blocks time-to-ready and pilot.

deploy-bot: Deploying `fleet-provisioner` to staging (flag `p2r_pipeline_v2=true`).

Vanessa Ortiz: Patch is in staging. I’m going to rerun Bootstrapping for `prun_8d2c` via CLI.
Command:
```
ri-fleet provision rerun-stage --pool ded-pilot-usw2-a10-07 --run prun_8d2c --stage bootstrapping
```

Harish Reddy: Watching. :eyes:

Vikram Singh: Control plane shows stage restarted. Helm job is running.

Vanessa Ortiz: Helm succeeded this time. Bootstrap logs:
```
Release "redwood-runtime" has been upgraded. Happy Helming!
...
bootstrapping: runtime installed
bootstrapping: waiting for rollout...
rollout complete
```
State transitioned to Validating.

Rafael Mendes: Great. Let’s rerun the other two runs.

Gabe Wilson: Kicking `prun_8d31` now.

Ethan Park: `prun_8d33` rerun started.

Connor O'Brien: Once validated, can we proceed with enabling the pilot checklist steps? I want to avoid a late-day surprise.

Miles Thornton: Before we declare all-clear, can we confirm retry storm stopped? Any stuck loops?

Vikram Singh: Retry counts stopped increasing. Bootstrapping succeeded on all three. Two are already in Validating, one still rolling out.

Harish Reddy: Perf-canary hasn’t run yet, but that’s validation stage. At least we’re past bootstrap.

Rafael Mendes: Root cause write-up (draft): pipeline emitted incorrect helm values type for runtime.env; helm template failed; fleet-provisioner retried bootstrapping indefinitely. Action: add schema/validation, add unit test, add metric for helm template errors to page earlier.

Kira Thompson: For the runbook, can we capture the operator-facing symptom string? e.g. “template … can’t evaluate field name…” so people can grep.

Vanessa Ortiz: Yep. The top-level error:
`UPGRADE FAILED: template: runtime/templates/deployment.yaml:145... can't evaluate field name in type interface {}`

deploy-bot: Deploying `fleet-provisioner` to production (staging-only flag remains; no global enable).

Ethan Park: Confirmed production deploy is safe; feature flag off by default. Only affects pilot pools when flag enabled.

Gabe Wilson: `prun_8d31` now in Validating.

Vikram Singh: `prun_8d33` also in Validating. Bootstrapping stage durations are back to normal (~9m).

Rafael Mendes: Mitigation successful. Let’s keep incident open until at least one run completes Validating (smoke + readiness suite) to be sure we didn’t introduce another config translation issue.

Harish Reddy: Validation results for `ded-pilot-usw2-a10-07`:
- GPU health: PASS
- DNS/TLS: PASS
- runtime smoke: PASS
- perf-canary readiness suite: PASS (throughput within threshold)
Control plane moved it to Ready.

Rafael Mendes: Perfect. We can resolve.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: *INCIDENT RESOLVED*
Resolution: Patched fleet-provisioner to coerce `runtime.env` values into chart-expected list form; reran Bootstrapping for affected provisioning runs. All affected runs progressed to Validating; at least one reached Ready.

Rafael Mendes: Follow-ups (assigning owners):
1) Add config schema rule: disallow map form for `runtime.env` (unless break-glass) + doc update (Owner: @Benji Okafor / @Jordan Lee)
2) Add unit test in fleet-provisioner for helm values rendering shape (Owner: @Gabe Wilson)
3) Add alert: bootstrapping helm template error rate + “stuck in Bootstrapping” paging threshold review (Owner: @Aisha Bello)
4) Runbook update: “Bootstrapping failures: helm values env shape” + rerun-stage commands (Owner: @Kira Thompson)
5) Postmortem-lite note in retro doc (Owner: @Vanessa Ortiz)

Connor O'Brien: I’ll add a note to rollout checklist: verify helm values lint passes before enabling flag for any new region/SKU.

Vanessa Ortiz: I’ll open a Linear issue for (1)-(3) and link this thread. Thanks all.
